evidence.detail: Template renders archetype tree, decks, cards, chart, and matchups — no description field displayed anywhere
__getattr__ forwards attribute lookups to self.archetype, so {{description}} in the template will resolve correctly
SQL query SELECTs a.description, so the field is present on returned archetype objects
update_description() exists, confirming descriptions are maintained in the archetype table

triage.fix_sketch:
Add {{#description}}

{{description}}

{{/description}} near the top of decksite/templates/archetype.mustache (e.g. before the Decks section). The description field is already fetched by load_archetypes() and accessible via __getattr__ in the Archetype view. No backend changes needed. The issue comment notes that some descriptions are admin-facing ('Put specific decks in a subarchetype'); the conditional block means only non-empty descriptions render, so updating descriptions is editorial work that can proceed independently.
triage.notes: Comment on the issue requests descriptions be rewritten to be player-facing rather than admin-facing; that is editorial work not code. The template change is ~3 lines and isolated.
